question_cn: 哪种棋子在实战中最容易孤军深入后被困死？
question_en: Which pieces are most likely to venture too far and become trapped in a game?

options.text_en: Pawns, because they are the most numerous
The king, because it is the most important piece

options.text_cn: 后和象——贪吃子力或位置冒进，进入对方阵地后退路被封
options.text_en: Queens and bishops, which may venture into enemy territory for material or position and find their retreat cut off
Rooks, because they can move only in straight lines

explanation_cn: 后和象在实战中最容易被困。后因为价值最高，对方会不惜代价围追堵截；象则容易走进被己方或对方兵封死的死角。开局时后和象不应过早深入对方阵地，要时刻保证有退路。
explanation_en: Queens and bishops are especially prone to being trapped. The queen is valuable enough for the opponent to spend time and pieces restricting it, while a bishop can become hemmed in by pawn structures. Avoid sending them deep into enemy territory too early, and make sure they retain an escape route.
